description: A new law intended to protect HOA residents in Colorado may need some revisions or clarifications according to the sponsor, after a CBS News Colorado investigation revealed one management company  charging high fees to send certified letters to HOA residents.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Naquetta Ricks for Colorado
title: LOCAL NEWS State lawmaker calls HOA charges "excessive" following CBS News Colorado investigation — State Representative Naquetta Ricks HD40
